jobs.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a NEW exercise instruction mother sheet, using the supplied image only as a visual style reference. Match the existing premium anatomy-aware 3D fitness illustration: realistic adult athlete, fitted modest cool-gray training clothes, flat translucent green #1F8A70 highlights on quadriceps, glutes and calves, natural body proportions, soft clinical studio lighting, plain light-gray floor and backdrop. NO text, numbers, labels, arrows, panel borders, logos or watermarks. Consistent same person, camera, clothing and machine in all panels. All head, hands, feet and complete equipment visible with safe margins. Mechanically correct contact points. Render precisely the specified panels in exact order; no extra people or stages.
Asset: motorized treadmill running. Output two equal side-by-side panels in a 1536x1024 sheet. Model: adult female athlete.
Stages: Left panel: left foot landing on moving belt beneath the hip, right leg bent behind, natural opposite arm swing. Right panel: right foot landing beneath hip, left leg behind, arms reversed. Maintain upright torso with slight whole-body lean, relaxed shoulders and elbows bent. Hands free, do not grip rails while running.
Equipment: One full unbranded motorized treadmill in each panel with wide running belt, low deck, upright front console and short handrails. Side three-quarter view showing the full belt and foot contact.
jobs.refinementPrompt: Edit this two-panel exercise guidance mother sheet. Preserve the entire LEFT panel exactly. Preserve the same woman, face, clothes, treadmill, lighting, green muscle overlays, neutral background and camera in the RIGHT panel, but change ONLY her right-panel pose to a visibly different running push-off phase: the visible near-side leg is extended backward with the toe just leaving the belt behind the hip, the other knee swings forward clearly bent and lifted, and arm swing reverses with the forward knee. The two silhouettes must clearly differ. Keep all body and equipment uncropped, NO text/logos/arrows. Same 1536x1024, two equal panels. Do not duplicate the left pose.
